author: durai-seed

sections.title: Bottom line
sections.instruction: Say replace, adapt or keep. Give three to five short points.

sections.title: Durai today
sections.instruction: List facts about Durai. Give file and line for each fact. Read the code first. Do not guess.

sections.title: Fact sheet per target
sections.instruction: Read primary pages first (repository, official docs). Give the URL for each fact. Mark a fact UNVERIFIED when no primary page shows it. Name each conflict between sources.

sections.title: One table per target
sections.instruction: Use the columns Area, What it gives, Durai today and the lack, Verdict, Cost. Put the line 'Replace anything?' under each table.

sections.title: Verdict words
sections.instruction: Use only ADOPT, ADAPT, KEEP, SKIP and REPLACE. ADOPT means use it behind a port. ADAPT means copy the idea and build it in Durai. KEEP means Durai is equal or better. SKIP means not now.

sections.title: Cost scale
sections.instruction: Use S for under 1 day, M for 2 to 5 days, L for more than 1 week. Say that costs are estimates. State the licence cost and the paid-call cost.

sections.title: What could not be verified
sections.instruction: List each claim without a primary source.

sections.title: Proposed phases
sections.instruction: List phases. Mark each one not started. Do not start any work.

sections.title: Decisions for the user
sections.instruction: List the choices the user must make.

sections.title: Sources
sections.instruction: List every URL with the date checked. Mark secondary sources.

instructions: Write short sentences in ASD-STE100 style.
Write the result to a research file in the plans folder. Show the tables in the chat.
Ask which Durai modules are in scope when the request does not say.
Do not start implementation. Write a plan file first.
